answer: SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' AND date(event_date) BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'
SELECT b.category FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location = 'MU 215' AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker' AND b.spent = 0
SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

SELECT b.category, SUM(e.cost) AS total_value_approved FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE b.link_to_event = (SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_name = 'October Meeting') AND e.approved = 'true' GROUP BY b.category
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE mj.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'
SELECT b.category, b.amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker' ORDER BY b.amount ASC
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.amount FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE date(i.date_received) = '2019-09-09'
SELECT mj.major_name FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Angela' AND m.last_name = 'Sanders'
